rationale: as_tensor truncates float soft_target_probs to int via astype(np.int_). Detected by hooking the dataloader op and asserting output_dtype matches input_dtype when input is float. Borderline dtype vs data_loading: chose data_loading because the failure surface is the dataset/collator path, not a model dtype mismatch. pi_precond=true (op==as_tensor on float array).
